verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Mailchimp's API can create contacts and has 'Predictive Segmentation' as a paid feature, but there is no documented endpoint or workflow for translating a plain-language audience description into a segment programmatically — no NLP-to-segment API, no agent-facing tool for this. missing for 10: an API/tool that accepts natural-language input and returns/creates a segment definition, any documentation of AI-driven segment creation via the programmatic surface.
